title: Ogbronuagum language - Wikipedia
text: Language family. Niger–Congo?Ogbronuagum, also called Bukuma after a village in which it is spoken, is a Central Delta language of Nigeria. Ogbronuagum is formed from the two words "Ogbronu" and "Agum", which would literally mean "the language of the people of Agum".
